name: Living Stack
tagline: Make agent work prove itself before it claims completion.
description: A local-first proof and control plane for AI agents: freeze scope and budget before action, bind outcomes to typed evidence, recover from signed checkpoints, and export a cryptographically signed trace. It exposes 14 bounded tools and no arbitrary shell, browser, or network executor.

install.notes: Requires Node.js 22+. State stays local by default; review the public security boundary before first use.
